title: Programs — WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology
description: WhiteHouse College of Business & Technology — Kathmandu University affiliated BIT and B.Tech Ed IT programs in Jhapa, Nepal.

paras: KU-partnered undergraduate programs designed for careers in software, IT services, and technology-enabled teaching across Nepal and beyond.

blocks.heading: Two programs, one standard of excellence
paras: Both degrees are delivered in partnership with Kathmandu University. Select the pathway that matches your career goals.

groups.title: BIT — Bachelor in Information Technology
text: Software engineering, databases, networking, and AI fundamentals for tech careers.

groups.title: B.Tech Ed IT — Technology in Education
text: Digital pedagogy, instructional design, and IT integration for modern educators.

blocks.heading: Nationally recognized qualifications
paras: Every program follows Kathmandu University curriculum standards, ensuring your degree is respected by employers and institutions across Nepal.

blocks.heading: Compare our programs
paras: Not sure which pathway fits you? Use this quick comparison to understand the focus, skills, and outcomes of each degree.

blocks.heading: Facilities that support every program
paras: Whether you pursue BIT or B.Tech Ed IT, you learn in labs and classrooms built for hands-on, collaborative work.

groups.title: AI & Innovation Lab
text: Experiment with machine learning, robotics, and prototype development.

groups.title: 24/7 Library Access
text: Digital and print resources for research and self-study.

groups.title: Smart Classrooms
text: Interactive displays and collaborative tools for modern teaching.
Premises of Nidi Secondary School & Indreni Campus

groups.title: Industry Mentorship
text: Guest lectures, hackathons, and placement workshops year-round.

blocks.heading: How to apply
paras: Admissions are open for the upcoming intake. Follow these steps to begin your application at WCBT Jhapa Campus.

groups.title: Check eligibility
text: Review academic requirements for +2 or equivalent qualifications in relevant streams.

groups.title: Submit application
text: Complete the online form with transcripts, identification, and program preference.

groups.title: Entrance assessment
text: Attend the admission test and interview scheduled by the admissions office.

groups.title: Enrollment
text: Confirm your seat, complete fee payment, and join orientation week.

blocks.heading: Where our graduates go
paras: Both programs open doors to in-demand careers — in tech companies, schools, startups, and public-sector innovation.

groups.title: Software Developer
text: Build web and mobile applications for startups, enterprises, and government projects.

groups.title: IT Support & Systems Admin
text: Manage networks, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise systems for organizations.

groups.title: Ed-Tech Specialist
text: Design digital curricula and learning platforms for schools and training institutes.

groups.title: ICT Teacher / Trainer
text: Lead technology classrooms and professional development programs nationwide.

groups.title: Data & AI Analyst
text: Turn data into insights for business, research, and public-sector innovation.

groups.title: Startup Founder
text: Launch ventures in software, education technology, and digital services.

blocks.heading: Ready to start your application?
paras: Join WCBT Jhapa Campus and earn a Kathmandu University partnered degree in BIT or B.Tech Ed IT.
